items.briefing:
New research from Commvault reveals that one in three organisations across Australia and New Zealand are still paying ransomware demands, despite advice from authorities to avoid doing so. This is a concerning trend, particularly as a cyberattack on global logistics firm Ceva is now spreading to affect businesses across its supply chain — a reminder that your organisation can be impacted even if you're not directly targeted.

If your business works with external suppliers or logistics providers, check whether any partners have reported recent incidents. **Practical tip:** Make sure you have offline or cloud backups of critical data that are kept separate from your main systems, so you have options if ransomware ever strikes.

featured.title: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, Commvault research says
featured.quote: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, revealing critical vulnerability in Australian cybersecurity resilience.
